parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
A wire is designed to ensure that its strain does not exceed $4.0 \times 10^{-4}$ when a force of 8.0 kN is applied. The Young modulus of the metal of the wire is $2.1 \times 10^{11}$ Pa. It may be assumed that the wire obeys Hooke’s law.
For a force of 8.0 kN, calculate, for the wire,

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
the minimum cross-sectional area.
minimum cross-sectional area = $m^{2}$
